title: cerinthe major subsp. purpurascens
intro: Cerinthe major subsp. purpurascens, commonly known as Honeywort or Purple Honeywort, is a flowering plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary purposes. The health benefits of Cerinthe major subsp. purpurascens include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues such as anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic effects.
